title: Game im working on for my self might realse one day what do you guys think.
author: Colorpunk1
selftext:
I originally started making this game just for myself, mainly as a fun little project. But the more it comes together, the more I'm enjoying what it's turning into.

I've put together a small trailer just for fun, partly to see if I could make one and partly to show off what I've been working on.

I'd genuinely like to hear what people think. Is this something you'd be interested in playing? Do you like the overall look and direction of it?

If people enjoy the concept, I'd definitely consider developing it further and adding more to it. For now, I'm just curious to see what other gamers think!
